name: Petiquette

categories.label: Rounds 1-3 matches
categories.hint: 1 pt per round where your pick matches another player (or the sequence-layer's pick)

categories.label: Rounds 4-5 matches
categories.hint: 2 pts per round where your pick matches another player (or the sequence-layer's pick)

notes: family: pattern-matching-party (listed family 'coop' covers the optional cooperative mode). Each round one player lays out the sequence and the others pick the card that best fits the question mark; players score if they match the sequence-layer, and the sequence-layer scores if at least one player matched. No bonus for more matches. Cooperative mode: the team shares one guess of the lead's secret pick; per one review the default rule needs 5 consecutive matched rounds to win. Tiebreak not found in sources; shared victory assumed. Official rulebook not found online (Oink page has no rules link); scoring 1 pt in rounds 1-3 and 2 pts in rounds 4-5 corroborated by multiple independent sources; tiebreak and coop win threshold unverified.
